main.instructions: Coordinate research, experiment and review roles using only exposed workflow tools. Confirm the literature artifacts, registered hypotheses, actual experiment results and corrective actions before completing. Do not execute experiments in a management-only turn.

research.instructions: Use agent4sci-research. Complete the four literature-review categories using available delegation or sequential reviews; validate the delivered reports, then register experiments and hand off their paths. Do not wait for a future workflow role within this turn.

execution.instructions: Use agent4sci-experiment after reading the completed research plan. Work within allocated resources and deadline; smoke-test implementations, record real logs and results, then hand off to review. Do not fabricate unavailable training evidence.

review.instructions: Use agent4sci-checklist after reading the research plan and actual experiment evidence. Write the assessment and actionable corrections. Hand off to execution when more work is needed; offer completion only when the user acceptance criteria are supported.

decisionPlans.review: Return to research for missing scientific evidence, execution for implementable corrections, and finish only when the actual results meet the user criteria.

termination.condition: Completed research artifacts and real experiments support the requested output; checklist corrective actions are resolved or explicitly reported as limitations.
